messages:
maria: Heads up — I'm seeing a bunch of child KV-fetch spans come up as independent trace roots from the prefetcher on prod. Parent HTTP span is present but the kv.fetch spans have new trace IDs. Sample: https://tempo.redwood.ai/trace/abcd1234

ashwin: Which service/runtime? java vs python? My hunch: context propagation lost across async executor (ForkJoin/commonPool).

maria: workers-v2 (java). Running java-opentelemetry agent 1.17.0. Prefetcher uses CompletableFuture.supplyAsync without an explicit executor: 
```
CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(() -> kvClient.get(key))
```
That defaults to ForkJoin.commonPool.

jamie: CommonPool often loses Context unless wrapped. Agent auto-instrumentation helps but there are edge cases. Quick options: provide an instrumented Executor, wrap supplier with Context.current() or use the agent's async propagation helper.

ashwin: Also look at sampling. Prod uses parentbased_traceidratio=0.02. If children become roots, sampling decisions differ and you get noisy independent traces. Confirm whether those orphan roots are sampled or just exporter artifacts.

maria: How do I check sampling decision on a given trace? Any dashboards or exporter logs to inspect?

runtime-ops: Links — prefetcher metrics: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/prefetcher/prefetcher-overview; trace UI: https://tempo.redwood.ai/trace/<trace_id>. For sampling flags, inspect span tags/attributes in the trace view (sampling.priority / x-cloud-trace-context). Also check worker logs (service=workers-v2) for exporter warnings like "DroppedSpan" or "failed to export".

jamie: For a quick canary hotfix try wiring an instrumented executor: 
```
ExecutorService exec = Instrumentation.wrap(Executors.newFixedThreadPool(n));
CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(() -> kv.get(k), exec);
```
Or if we have runtimeCommons.getInstrumentedExecutor() in shared libs, use that. That preserves Context and should stop orphan roots.

ashwin: Verify agent bootstrap args in the systemd unit file too. We saw a config where async propagation was disabled via a bootstrap property. I can diff prod vs canary agent args if you want.

maria: Will deploy a canary with the instrumented executor and grep exporter logs for "DroppedSpan". I'll post a new trace id after the canary run. Starting now. :thumbsup:

jamie: If it persists after instrumenting, drop a trace id + the worker threadpool stack dump here and we'll inspect. (react :eyes:)

sre-bot: Canary deploy started for canary/workers-v2 by maria — job 4521. ETA ~3m.
